newsitem.title: USA: Dow Chemical in specialty foams venture.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chemical in specialty foams venture.

text.p: Dow Chemical Co said Wednesday it signed a letter of intent with Sentinel Products Corp to form a 50-50 joint venture that would include a broad portfolio of specialty foams used in cushion packaging.

The foams would be made using Dow's proprietary INSITE Technology Polymers. The joint venture would include design, development, manufacturing, marketing, and sales of extruded polyolefin and engineered metallocene foams globally.

Both companies will transfer to the venture their manufacturing facilities related to the production of these products. Dow's facilities are located in Hanging Rock, Ohio, and Drusenheim, France. Sentinel, based in Hyannis, Mass., has facilities in Richfield Springs and St. Johnsville, N.Y.
In addition, both companies will make available to the venture technologies necessary to manufacture a broad line of extruded foam and engineered metallocene foam products.

"This joint venture will strengthen our position in cushion packaging. The capabilities of both companies complement each other in a way that will create value for the customer," William Lorden, global business director for Dow's Cushion Packaging business, said in a statement.
